name: Mr. Bennet
brief: An odd mixture of quick parts, sarcastic humour, reserve, and caprice.

name: Mrs. Bennet
brief: A woman of mean understanding, little information, and uncertain temper, whose business in life is to get her daughters married.

name: Elizabeth
brief: One of the Bennet daughters, possessed of a lively, playful disposition which delights in anything ridiculous.

name: Jane
brief: The eldest Miss Bennet, the most beautiful creature Mr. Bingley ever beheld, much admired by him.

name: Lydia
brief: The youngest daughter of the Bennet family, stout and tall, eager for dancing and partners.

name: Kitty
brief: One of the younger Bennet daughters.

name: Mary
brief: A young lady of deep reflection who reads great books and makes extracts.

name: Mr. Bingley
brief: A good-looking, gentlemanlike young man of large fortune with a pleasant countenance and easy, unaffected manners.

name: Mr. Darcy
brief: A proud and disagreeable gentleman of large estate in Derbyshire with ten thousand a year.

name: Miss Bingley
brief: Mr. Bingley's sister, a fine woman with an air of decided fashion.
